text:
sasha: Quick follow-up on the RFC — propose adding 'profile inheritance' for quantization profiles so model-family defaults can be overridden per-model. This avoids duplicating tiny diffs across many models. Thoughts? :thinking:

kevin: Love the idea. Implementation question: runtime needs to resolve inheritance on load vs on-demand. Load-time resolution adds memory cost but keeps inference hot path simple.

nina: We should prefer load-time for production (predictable latency) but expose a config toggle for low-memory setups. Also need a clear compatibility story for older profiles.

kevin: Agree. We also need to add `base_profile_id` to the profile schema and runtime should materialize final profile before serving.

sasha: Draft schema example:
```json
{
  "profile_id": "redwood.fp8.large",
  "base_profile_id": "redwood.fp8.base",
  "overrides": {
    "attention_qkv_scale": 0.98,
    "weight_clip": 0.003
  }
}
```

ryan: Two tradeoffs to flag: 1) Implicit inheritance can hide regressions if base changes; 2) Rollouts become multi-level. Need rollout tooling to pin base+derived together.

nina: Telemetry reqs we should add: `degradation_score`, `calibration_delta`, `profile_resolution_version`. That makes audit and rollbacks easier.

quant-bot: lint://profile-schema failed for redwood.fp8.large — missing `schema_version`. See docs.

kevin: Good catch. We should make `schema_version` required and include a runtime `resolved_from` field in logs. e.g. `resolved_from: ["redwood.fp8.base","redwood.fp8.optim"]`.

sasha: For safety: add per-route `degradation_budget` (0..1). Runtime will reject derived profiles if estimated quality loss > budget.

ryan: How do we estimate quality loss? We have per-profile calibration metrics (perplexity delta, span-f1). If a profile lacks evals, default to conservative fallback to full-precision.

nina: Ops playbook: when fallback occurs, emit an alert with `profile_id`, `route`, `reason`, and `sample_prompt` for repro.

sasha: Action items:
- kevin: design load-time materializer + `resolved_profile` cache (PR)
- nina: telemetry schema + alert format
- ryan: rollout tooling change to pin base/derived + canary checks
- sasha: update RFC text with schema example + safety rules

kevin: I'll start the materializer PR today, tagging @ops for memory/ops review.

nina: I'll add telemetry fields to the eval pipeline.

ryan: I'll prototype budget estimation script and run on a couple of production routes.

sasha: cool, thanks. If anyone wants to meet I'll set a 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
